fact: Burundi's Loi N°1/07 of 11 May 2018 on the national payment system is a promulgated law, held by the central bank as an official text (the document is an image-only scan of it, with no body text).
system: Loi N°1/07 du 11 mai 2018 portant système national de paiement

fact: The central bank's oversight framework (published 2025-11-20, date taken from the file name) cites Loi n°1/07 of 11 May 2018 on the national payment system as the current law, whose article 9 lets the bank issue regulations and instructions on payment systems, operators and issuers of payment instruments.
system: Loi n°1/07 du 11 mai 2018 portant système national de paiement

fact: The framework cites Règlement n°002/2024, revising Règlement n°001/2017 on payment services and payment institutions, which says no one may provide payment services without the central bank's licence; its date within 2024 is not given.
system: Règlement n°002/2024 relatif aux services de paiement et aux activités des établissements de paiement

fact: Under Règlement n°002/2024 the central bank licenses payment institutions (établissements de paiement), which the framework lists apart from commercial banks and microfinance institutions as operators of e-money platforms, and it requires every licensed payment service provider to be inspected on site at least every two years.
